geo_title_biopython: Longitudinal single-cell transcriptomics analysis of mouse lung upon bleomycin-induced injury
geo_summary_biopython: Two single-cell RNA sequencing data sets were generated called "Whole lung" and "High Resolution". The "Whole lung" single-cell mRNAseq libraries were generated with Drop-Seq from whole mouse lungs upon bleomycin-induced injury and followed over time. Samples were taken at days 3 (n = 3), 7 (n = 5), 10 (n = 3), 14 (n = 4), 21 (n = 4) and 28 (n = 2). Control samples (n = 7) were administered saline only, also indicated with PBS or day0. The "High resolution" single-cell mRNAseq libraries were generated with Drop-Seq from the epithelial compartment of mouse lungs upon bleomycin-induced injury and followed over time. Samples were taken daily for two weeks and at days 21, 28, 36, 54 after injury. Control samples (n = 2) were administered saline only, also indicated with PBS or day0.
